name: decouple-core-cli-workflow-guidance
description: Replaces CLI command strings, slash commands and bypass flags in the @specd/core lifecycle, status and validity projections with host-neutral phase intents and check-declared actions, which the CLI renders through a guidance presenter. Checks now own their failure reporting and skippability, legacy parking states are gated by checks, spec consent is renewed in `ready`, and committed recoveries are rendered as repair guides. Status, transition, archive, invalidate, approve, edit and verification output is aligned across text, JSON and TOON.
